scope: First collection: birds/parrots. Original summaries only; raw samples excluded from public output.

resources.title: Evidence for vocal signatures and voice-prints in a wild parrot
resources.task: Caller identity across call types; a candidate source for context-label feasibility.
resources.review_depth: Primary abstract and introduction via institutional PDF; repository documentation. Full statistical methods and supplement not yet reviewed.
resources.access: Institutional full text readable; publisher request returned 403.
resources.decision: Read methods next; no translation or causal meaning claim.
resources.limitations: Reported vocal individuality does not establish that birds recognize those cues or that an AI knows call meaning. No replication performed.
resources.attribution: Smeele, Senar, Aplin and McElreath (2023), DOI 10.1098/rsos.230835.

rights.scope: Article text; no automatic license for linked data/code.
rights.conditions: Credit authors/source and indicate changes. This collection publishes original summaries and links only.

resources.title: Monk parakeet vocal-signature analysis code
resources.task: Reproducible acoustic comparisons and identity analysis.
resources.review_depth: README, license, file tree, commit and downloaded data-preparation/MFCC scripts inspected; no execution or complete code audit.
resources.decision: Acquire a small code sample; inspect before any execution.
resources.limitations: Selected files are not a complete runnable environment or reproduced result. R/Stan dependencies and large supporting files are absent. Scripts install packages dynamically and source unpinned helpers. The MFCC sample uses globally scaled distances; implement train-only preprocessing for any new held-out classifier.
resources.attribution: Simeon Quirinus Smeele; copyright 2022; related Smeele et al. (2023).

rights.scope: Repository code; Edmond v1 separately declares MIT for the deposited dataset.
rights.conditions: Retain the copyright and permission notice. No warranty. Do not infer permission for omitted third-party files.

resources.admission_reason: MIT notice verified at the pinned commit; sample is static code and documentation only.

resources.title: Monk parakeet 2020 annotation table
resources.task: Inspect observed behavior, uncertainty and individual identifiers for a possible context-association task.
resources.review_depth: README field definitions, Git tree checksums, Edmond v1 license metadata and downloaded 2020 annotation table inspected; aggregate report in research/parrot_sample_report.json.
resources.access: Small GitHub metadata file; full Edmond archives total 100498691932 bytes and are not selected.
resources.decision: Sample acquired and inspected: 808 rows, 752 populated behavior entries and 176 distinct nonempty behavior strings. Require selection-table/audio linkage and an independent label audit before training admission.
resources.limitations: No audio acquired. Annotations are free text; a field named context elsewhere describes call sequence structure. Behavior labels cannot be assumed independent, exhaustive or suitable. Full recording overview includes coordinates and is excluded.
resources.attribution: Smeele et al. (2023); data DOI 10.17617/3.RUIM5I v1.0; GitHub snapshot separately pinned.

rights.scope: Edmond dataset v1.0 explicitly declares MIT; selected table is in the linked MIT repository.
rights.conditions: Retain MIT notice and dataset attribution. Keep original notes local; review location/privacy and third-party provenance before any sharing.

resources.admission_reason: Depositor API reports MIT for released v1.0 and the linked pinned repository carries MIT; only a small metadata table is selected, without recording coordinates or audio.

resources.title: Perch-Hoplite embedding and model tooling
resources.task: Embedding search, annotation and lightweight classifier workflows.
resources.review_depth: Official README, license and pinned model configuration acquired; configuration entries inspected. No installation or model audit.
resources.decision: Acquire documentation/configuration to guide integration; defer installation and weights.
resources.limitations: Code license does not prove rights for every model, input dataset or downstream use. No inference performed.
resources.attribution: Google Research / Perch-Hoplite contributors; Apache-2.0 notices in source.

rights.conditions: Retain applicable license, copyright and NOTICE terms; track modifications. Model and dataset terms require separate review.

resources.admission_reason: Official Apache-2.0 repository; immutable configuration and documentation sample, not installed or executed.

resources.title: Perch 2 CPU model candidate
resources.review_depth: Same-day model decision reused; CPU bundle terms and signatures have not been inspected.
resources.access: CPU-specific card did not render in the earlier review; no model package downloaded.
resources.decision: Retain candidate; block weights until exact package terms and provenance are inspected.
resources.limitations: No runtime/accuracy result. Pretraining overlap remains unknown. Parent-model license is not a substitute for inspecting selected artifact.
resources.attribution: Google Perch team; see official model card.

rights.scope: Parent card only; selected binary unverified.
rights.conditions: Inspect exact bundle and applicable notices before use.

resources.title: BirdVox-DCASE-20k
resources.task: Bird-vocalization presence detection; not observed behavior.
resources.review_depth: Depositor description, label definitions, file inventory and Conditions of Use reviewed.
resources.access: 16.5 GB ZIP advertised; no small file selected.
resources.decision: Metadata only; potential detector benchmark, not the first context dataset.
resources.limitations: Bird/no-bird labels; sensor/time origin of excerpts is hidden from participants, limiting leakage-safe reconstruction of field splits. No known individual identities.
resources.attribution: Lostanlen, Salamon, Farnsworth, Kelling and Bello; cite BirdVox-full-night (ICASSP 2018).

rights.scope: Dataset and contents under depositor Conditions of Use.
rights.conditions: Credit creators/source and indicate changes. No warranty.

resources.title: BEANS-Next
resources.review_depth: Official card/visible schema rechecked; prior Croissant review reused. Full row-by-row audit not performed.
resources.access: Public dataset card; audio not downloaded.
resources.decision: Metadata only. Keep public test examples out of training for any independent benchmark claim.
resources.limitations: Mixed source licenses and heterogeneous tasks; descriptive text is not automatically independently observed behavioral ground truth.
resources.attribution: Earth Species Project and the underlying source-dataset creators.

rights.scope: Dataset card and per-record license fields; not a uniform permissive corpus.
rights.conditions: Audit each underlying source and preserve noncommercial/share-alike restrictions and benchmark splits.

resources.title: Experimental evidence for compositional syntax in bird calls
resources.task: Behavioral playback controls for claims about meaning and call order.
resources.review_depth: Existing same-day methods review reused from content/research.json; no new full-text review in this collection.
resources.access: Original summary/source links already in the project library.
resources.decision: Retain as study-design reference; initial Talk2Nature acquisition stays passive.
resources.limitations: Species-specific controlled experiment; cannot establish general translation. No new playback is authorized.
